families.label: Media, Publishing and Entertainment
families.definition: Creation, publication, printing, licensing, distribution, and streaming of news, books, periodicals, film, television, and other media content.

capabilities.label: News and periodical publishing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to commission, produce, edit, publish, distribute, and sustain news, magazine, journal, or other recurring editorial products.

capabilities.label: Book and digital publishing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to acquire, edit, produce, license, publish, distribute, and manage books or comparable long-form digital works.

capabilities.label: Commercial printing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to reproduce publications, packaging, marketing materials, transactional documents, or other printed products at commercial scale.

capabilities.label: Film and television production
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to develop, finance, produce, manage, and complete film, television, or episodic audiovisual content for commercial distribution.

capabilities.label: Media content distribution
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to license, schedule, aggregate, market, and distribute media content through broadcast, theatrical, physical, digital, or syndicated channels.

capabilities.label: Streaming media service
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate subscription, advertising-supported, or transactional services that deliver on-demand or live media over digital networks.
